content: For inline tag pills, a code-editor component (CodeMirror 6) with mark/widget Decorations is a better fit than raw contentEditable or a rich-text framework (Lexical/ProseMirror), because it treats content as plain text (matches 'source of truth is a plain text file' requirement) while letting you overlay non-destructive visual decorations (pills) via regex-scanned ranges without mutating the underlying string.
